title: Move from DevNovel to Storybook
body:
In the next major release Storybook (v4 still in alpha) will support [HTML application](https://github.com/storybooks/storybook/blob/master/docs/src/pages/basics/guide-html/index.md). It can be a good opportunity to move our showcase from [DevNovel](https://github.com/algolia/dev-novel) to Storybook to leverage the community & plugins of Storybook. It also brings consistency across our different flavours since React & Vue are already on Storybook. 

Related https://github.com/algolia/angular-instantsearch/issues/226
